verdict.rationale: Statsig documents an official MCP server that brings Statsig into agent tools like Codex, Cursor, and Claude Code, and lets users "talk to your Statsig projects" from ChatGPT. It also has a Console API and a separate product-analytics surface (Metrics Explorer, Warehouse Native). However, nothing shows that the MCP server or the APIs can actually run analytics queries over live product or warehouse data to answer growth questions; the documented APIs cover console CRUD and gate/config evaluation plus event logging. Missing for 10: documented MCP tools or API endpoints for querying metrics and analytics data, warehouse SQL query execution via agent, an OpenAPI spec (probe 404), and hands-on corroboration of agents answering growth questions.
